pairs.evidence: features/graph/components/TrailFinder.tsx:190 Path search enforces a gate condition (edges a human rejected are kept out of the neighbourhood, and the count travels in PathQueryResult.excludedRejected and in the permalink JSON-LD), but the TrailFinder empty state and rule note never print that count, even though graphTypes.ts and trailPath.ts both say 'the surface prints it'. pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: scripts/gen-migration.ts:9 The schema-snapshot drift check is cheap and deterministic and needs nothing a workstation lacks, yet it is wired only into the remote CI rung (not into `npm run check` or the pre-push hook). Content can pass the repo's local gate and still fail CI, which is the unconsidered placement gate-laddering names.

techniques.evidence: scripts/gen-migration.ts:9 It qualifies for no hard-pass slot (no clean room, credentials or full-tree cost needed), but it runs only in .github/workflows/ci.yml:88 and is absent from package.json `check` and from lefthook pre-push.
scripts/gen-migration.ts:46 Drift exits non-zero inside a CI step, so the finding fails the run. It is not just printed.

scripts/gen-migration.ts:44 The remedy is a script declared in package.json (db:snapshot), and running it as worded rewrites the file the check compares against. restore.ts:69 likewise points to a memo file that exists.
scripts/gen-migration.ts:42 The check compares against the imported CORE_DDL value (the resolved artifact) and normalises CRLF so the haystack matches what is meant.
scripts/gen-migration.ts:37 A missing snapshot file is a failure, not a clean pass, so the instrument is asserted before the result.

scripts/db/migrate.ts:55 'Nothing pending' is kept apart from 'snapshot skipped'. An unprotected additive apply is announced on its own line (migrate.ts:75), and an unprotected destructive one is refused (migrate.ts:71).

techniques.evidence: features/money/casesReviewSource.test.ts:27 Presence is read from raw source with comments in; line 80 (AUDIT_READ_CAP) does the same. Line 51 normalises the haystack in the same file without saying why, which is the unexplained raw read the technique names.
